prompt.alinti: You should see this new tool for testing Wi-Fi. It's called WiFit 3, and it currently has 968 stars on GitHub. Usually testing your home network's security is a massive headache because you have to deal with complicated software that only works on one specific type of computer. This project fixes that by putting everything you need into one simple program that runs on Windows, Mac, or Linux without any extra setup. Think of it like a universal remote control for your wireless adapters that lets you scan for weak spots in your signal. It handles all the technical heavy lifting for you, so you don't have to worry about broken drivers or confusing settings. You can use it to spot hidden networks that are trying to stay out of sight or see exactly how secure your connections really are. It even helps you track how your devices communicate with your network's security. It works with your router, so you can see if something looks out of place. It's perfect if you're curious about how wireless traffic moves through your home and want to keep your network protected.

akis.ne: Wi-Fi ağlarını pasif olarak dinler ve 'Passively Listening for Crackable PKIDs' mesajını gösterir.
WPS PIN veya PSK şifreleri için otomatik yakalama yapar ve 'auto-capturing PSk' mesajını gösterir.
Deauthentikasyon işlemini başlatır ve 'Deauth all' komutunu uygular.
Kullanıcıya 'Tuned to channel X' ve 'CLIENTS (X)' gibi ağ bilgilerini gösterir.
